beats.summary: Angela questions Oscar about revealing their relationship on camera.

evidence.snippet: Angela (Plays boom box to drown out sound): Alright, how much have you revealed on camera about your relationship with the senator?
Angela: Oh! Stop it! Stop kissing him! Someone needs to call and warn him. This could ruin his career.

beats.summary: Pam and Brian discuss the privacy issues related to their past recordings.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Well, the promo for the documentary aired today.

beats.summary: Jim and Ryan create a humorous, exaggerated baseball promo involving Jim loving someone and Darth Vader.

evidence.snippet: Jim: "Together we will win this baseball game against the evil space Yankees. Eat Fresh."

beats.summary: Dwight and Esther discuss their relationship and the leasing of a tractor.

evidence.snippet: Esther: You need to tell him you want a deal based on miles or he can just stick that tractor where the sun don't shine.

beats.summary: Angela and Oscar reveal that their relationship might be exposed in the promos.
Andy plays a video message and reacts emotionally to comments from haters.

evidence.snippet: Andy (on video): Hey! TexasPoonTappa and JasonJasonJason and all the rest of you haters out there! Check this out.
Andy: Huh? Yeah, see ya. Oh! What?!

notable_quotes.quote: You want to know how much stuff you got.
